contribution: Development of empirical methods for estimating demand and market equilibrium in differentiated-product industries (modern empirical industrial organization, the BLP approach)
rationale: This is a forecast, not known fact. Recent prizes have favored empirical and methodological advances (2021, 2024, 2025). Empirical IO demand estimation, from Berry, Levinsohn and Pakes, is widely used in antitrust, trade and policy work and has not yet been recognized. Other plausible fields include trade (Helpman, Melitz) and public finance.
